newsitem.title: USA: Lincoln National to operate in Singapore.
newsitem.headline: Lincoln National to operate in Singapore.

text.p: Lincoln National Corp said Thursday its Lincoln National Reassurance division received permission from officials in Singapore to write life and health reinsurance policies from a recently opened office in Singapore.

The company said the new office is a major step toward fully supporting markets in southeast Asia. The office will be known as the Southeast Asia Reinsurance Branch of Lincoln National Reassurance, the company said.
Lincoln National is a financial services holding company.
Its shares were trading up 1/4 Thursday at 58-3/8.
